notes.title: ShaderGlass v1.2.2
notes.content:
Minor bugfix release:

[list]
[*] workaround for browser video blanking out when inactive
[*] fix for moving mouse to top or left screen edges showing cursor
[/list]

notes.title: ShaderGlass v1.2.1
notes.content:
Minor bugfix release around device capture:

[list]
[*] allow hardware transforms in device capture (less lag, more fps)
[*] fix Pixel Size not saving with device profiles
[*] ignore bad capture devices/formats
[/list]

notes.title: ShaderGlass v1.2.0
notes.content: [p]New major release of ShaderGlass. Changes since v1.1.4:[/p][list][*][p]device capture input (webcam/capture card) - apply shaders over webcam or another PC/console using a USB capture card[/p][/*][*][p]improved "Capture Cursor" function now attempting to hide the original mouse cursor[/p][/*][*][p]ability to edit global hotkeys[/p][/*][*][p]new global hotkeys: Capture Cursor, Shader Active, Toggle Menu (also in fullscreen!)[/p][/*][*][p]added Sonkun's presets and shader library update[/p][/*][*][p]minor QoL tweaks and fixes [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you're having issues with the new version, you can switch to 1.1 branch using Steam Betas.[/p]

notes.title: ShaderGlass v1.1.6 beta
notes.content: [p]Changes in v1.1.5 beta plus:[/p][list][*][p]ability to edit global hotkeys[/p][/*][*][p]new global hotkey: Capture Cursor on/off[/p][/*][*][p]new global hotkey: Shader Active on/off[/p][/*][*][p]new global hotkey: Toggle Menu (allows bringing up menu even in fullscreen)[/p][/*][*][p]add Pixel Size slider and Parameters button to Shader Browser window[/p][/*][*][p]fix for dialog windows so they don't get covered behind main window[/p][/*][/list][p]Not planning any more bigger changes for now, this will likely become v1.2 stable[/p][p]Thank you for testing & feedback, much appreciated![/p][p][/p][p]To try the new beta, switch Steam to "beta" branch (right-click in Steam library, Properties -> Betas -> Beta Participation).[/p]

notes.title: ShaderGlass v1.1.5 beta
notes.content: [p]New beta introducing two new features:[/p][list][*][p]device capture input (webcam/capture card) - apply shaders on top of webcam or another PC/console using a USB capture card[/p][/*][*][p]when "Capture Cursor" is enabled in Glass mode, original mouse cursor will be hidden[/p][/*][/list][p]Testing and feedback would be most appreciated - especially mouse cursor hiding has been tough since it requires full mouse emulation, extraction of pointer images, including those new colorful ones, DPI scaling etc. 😵‍💫 There might be cases where it won't apply but hopefully should be good enough.[/p][p][/p][p]To try the new beta, switch Steam to "beta" branch (right-click in Steam library, Properties -> Betas -> Beta Participation).[/p]

notes.title: ShaderGlass v1.1.4
notes.content:
[p]Minor bugfix release:

[/p][list][*][p] fix high-refresh capture (removes 65fps limit) - make sure to enable "Max Capture Rate" in "Processing -> Advanced" menu and restart ShaderGlass if you have a >60 Hz monitor[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ShaderGlass v1.1.2
notes.content: [p]Minor bugfix release: [/p][list][*][p]fix input alignment when using multiple monitors with different DPIs[/p][/*][*][p]fix saving of changes to preset overrides in profile files[/p][/*][*][p]show .gifs in input load dialog[/p][/*][*][p]remove obsolete "x" shortcut key[/p][/*][*][p]fix mirror/repeat stages (adds bezel reflections on koko-aio) [/p][/*][/list]
